summary: Retested mission idempotency and core frontend/backend flows. The first completion awards XP once and the second returns already_completed with zero XP; bootstrap, chats, navigation, role switching, and mission status UI passed.
action_items: Remove the hardcoded fallback URL from /app/backend/tests/test_public_api.py and require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Mission completion uses a conditional progress update before incrementing XP, which prevents duplicate rewards under the tested sequential repeat flow.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; one existing uncompleted mission was completed during the idempotency check, and test chat messages were persisted in the demo database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested regression flows passed. Mission-5 is now completed in the shared demo data; use another reset/uncompleted mission or inspect response semantics for future repeat tests.
rca of the issue: The prior duplicate-XP defect is mitigated by atomically conditioning the mission update on progress < goal; the no-op update returns already_completed=true and xp=0, so the student XP increment is skipped.
